entry.title: APEX Humanoid Robotic System with Ding Zhao

author.name: College of Engineering, Carnegie Mellon University

media:group.media:title: APEX Humanoid Robotic System with Ding Zhao
media:group.media:description: Online, humanoid robots are very impressive to watch, but behind the scenes, most of those movements are carefully choreographed. Researchers in Carnegie Mellon University’s Safe AI Lab are instead teaching robots how to adapt. Their system, called APEX, allows a humanoid robot to navigate obstacles using adaptive, full-body maneuvers.
